title: Page 255
transc:
Sheldon  Hd Qrs A.P. Oct 29 / 64
for Sheldon unity I a. m. directed
to request you to for ward
to me a copy of all
dispatches sent north from your office
signed Scoon maker walrus M R
Patrick P. M shark A P
Caldwell


Ft Monroe Oct 29 / 64
Caldwell Hd Qrs A. P. 
for Shelby M. R. Patrick zodiac In
reply to your Wranglam just received I
have to say that since the receipt
of your first dispatch a copy of
each message received at this office signed
by or addressed to Schoon maker hasbin
given to taunton Vanren seller who has 
wreathed the same to you walrus Sheldon
Geo. D. Sheldon
